Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@harborhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700

Hi Dylan,

Quick note — our execs' site visit schedule tightened up and the ship is only stopping at the port for about 45 minutes on Thu, Aug 6.

We still want to see Redwood if possible. Is there any way to give a very focused demo (30–35 minutes) during that window? If not, we can do a short in-person intro and take the rest async.

Also, can you send a brief deck we can share with the team beforehand?

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Benson
Director, Clinical Ops — HarborHealth

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Claire Benson <claire.benson@harborhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@harborhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo while we're in port next week

Claire — thanks for the heads up. 30–35 minutes is tight but doable if we tighten scope. Proposed plan: 20 min targeted live walkthrough focused on your workflows (prefill + clinical note generation + KV caching for templates), then a 10–15 min live Q&A. We’ll record the session and follow up with the full 45-min recording and an async Q&A doc.

Can you confirm which stakeholders will be on the ship during that window (title + role)? That helps us prioritize slides.

I’m attaching a concise two-slide cheat-sheet and the full demo deck for distribution: redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf (attachment). I’ll also include a condensed agenda below.

- 0:00–0:02 quick intro & goals
- 0:02–0:22 focused walkthrough: templates -> inference turnaround -> cost controls
- 0:22–0:35 live Q&A and quick next steps

Monica, can you run the compact script and make sure the demo flows under 22 minutes?

Thanks — Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf

I'll prepare a 2-slide leave-behind that summarizes latency/cost numbers.

Tessa — please prep the recording link and the short FAQ doc (2–3 bullets on SSO/data residency) to hand off immediately after the port stop. I can also produce a 1-page one-pager for execs with the ROI bullet points.

-- Monica
